resolution.question: Brightline ships its v4 release at a fixed time on Tuesday. Will the CEO post a launch announcement, and at least one of the three design partners publicly repost it, within 24 hours of the ship time?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the CEO posted a launch announcement on social media after the ship time and before 2026-09-16T10:00:00-07:00, AND at least one of the three design partners publicly reposted that announcement within the same 24-hour window. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
